findings.statement: D-1/task 3.2: any outcome outside the expected set (RECORD_MISMATCH, USAGE, other codes, exit 3) is read as 'отказ CLI 0.8 на базе kernel 0.7' and triggers the v0.8.1 fallback. Local preconditions are named only as merge commit + GITHUB_REPOSITORY; gh auth/GH_TOKEN is not (judgeRefs of APPROVED and the DECISION check call the forge: FORGE_UNAVAILABLE exit 3), and a RECORD_MISMATCH/USAGE caused by the Change itself or the local setup is not told apart from a factory refusal.
findings.recommendation: Name gh auth/GH_TOKEN as a precondition of 3.2; say that FORGE_UNAVAILABLE/USAGE of the local setup is repeated after fixing the setup, and only a code tied to the base lock/pack (kernel 0.7, pack 0.3.3) leads to the v0.8.1 path.

findings.statement: Process text: 'исправить до APPROVED — --replace'. After the spec-PR is merged (base record SPECIFIED) the impl-PR may not change resolved_as or empty resolution/ref of base unknowns[] (REQ-VER-011, ADR-0040 p.3: RECORD_MISMATCH). --replace with another --as (e.g. fact -> assumption) in the impl-PR before the APPROVED commit is allowed by CLI (state SPECIFIED) but reddens the job.
findings.recommendation: State: --replace freely in the spec-PR; after merge of the spec-PR only without changing --as, the decision ref still in the spec-PR.

findings.statement: Waiver path: spec edit after approval is limited to design.md I-N and delta spec, 'proposal.md вне write_scope'. The process text does not say what the agent does when the maintainer's decision requires a change of proposal.md (part of the spec-approved contract, ADR-0024 p.1): under guard the path is unreachable and the agent is left without a step.
findings.recommendation: Add: a needed proposal.md change — stop and ask the maintainer (edit by the maintainer in the impl-PR under the same waiver, or a new Change).

findings.statement: Waiver command text '--expires <не раньше archive-PR, например +90 дней>' while REQ-KRN-031 requires --expires <YYYY-MM-DD> (not earlier than today UTC, else USAGE); a relative '+90 дней' is not an accepted value.
findings.recommendation: Write '--expires <YYYY-MM-DD не раньше archive-PR, например сегодня + 90 дней>'.

findings.statement: Review 2 findings closed: F-1 (maintainer activates the waiver himself and commits to the impl-PR branch), F-2 (spec-PR, draft if needed, opened on blocking UNKNOWN), F-3 (expires covers archive-PR), F-4 (D-1 reason restated: gates by pack 0.3.4 before lock), F-5 (task 3.2 after VERIFYING, GATE_NOT_PASSED with ATTESTATION_REQUIRED expected), F-6 (fallback via I-N + spec-approved waiver). Consistent with REQ-VER-013, core-sdd risk-high, BL-74, ADR-0041.

assumptions.statement: CLI 0.8 ci uses its bundled pack 0.3.4 as law for the impl-PR (base lock hash absent -> factory-change required, REQ-VER-011); code of core/ci not read beyond decisions.ts header.
